class.name: GDCubismMotionQueueEntryHandle
class.description: The result of starting a native motion. Each accepted playback has one terminal result. Retained handles remain safe after stopping or destroying the model. Check is_finished before awaiting finished because a rejected request is already terminal.

method.name: get_error
method.description: Whether the original request was accepted. An accepted handle remains OK after termination.

method.name: is_finished
method.description: True after termination or immediate rejection.

method.name: get_reason
method.description: Returns PLAYING or the stable terminal reason.

signal.name: finished
signal.description: Emitted once, deferred outside SDK iteration, for an accepted playback's terminal transition. Immediate rejections are already finished and do not emit this signal.

members.member: Whether the original start_motion request was accepted.

constants.constant: Model unloaded or left the tree.
Model replaced by a load request.
